independent_checks.reason_author_suites_not_invoked: The read-only review did not authorize their temporary-root, cloned-source, or staging-file writes. Their sealed author results were preserved but not treated as independent evidence.

blocking_findings.reproduction: The slot-only adapter still permits ordinary assignment to _authority_public_key and _authority_verification_key_sha256. Same-process code can install a rogue verifier and matching digest, then supply a matching callback whose complete protocol flow is accepted.

The constructor resolves and may create any caller-provided nonsymlink Path. It has no allowlist, protected-root exclusion, project/person/profile/Creator separation, or authority binding, so non-production is a label rather than an enforced boundary.

A durable external COMMIT_STATIC_STAGE may succeed, after which a signed outer response can fail authority cross-binding or ticket/receipt validation before commit_receipt is assigned. The outer failure removes local output but attempts external rollback only when commit_receipt is non-null, leaving an unrecovered remote commit.

The exclusive output descriptor is closed before callbacks. Failure cleanup later trusts only the pathname and symlink status, so a concurrent rename/replacement or hardlink can cause cleanup to delete a replacement object while the candidate output survives elsewhere.

required_next_step: Preserve V2. Repair append-only as integration candidate V3 with an immutable externally anchored verifier, an actually enforced non-production staging boundary, recovery after every possibly durable commit response including signed-but-invalid responses, and stable file-handle/file-identity cleanup. Keep disconnected/default-off and require another different fresh static audit before any promotion.
